main_subject.description: An adult woman with long dark wind-tossed hair, a composed expression, and natural luminous skin.
main_subject.wardrobe: A charcoal sleeveless high-neck top, relaxed dark high-waisted trousers, and small unbranded silver earrings.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Low-angle candid portrait: she holds two cooked barbecue skewers safely apart at chest height and smiles subtly toward camera.

composition_elements.setting: A busy night-market food stall with warm bulbs, soft steam, distant anonymous shoppers, and abstract out-of-focus signage.
composition_elements.framing: Low-angle medium portrait with shallow depth of field and the stall's warm light behind the subject.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No anime character reference, food-stall name, readable signage, logos, labels, or text.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Warm yellow practical lights with soft glow and deep nighttime background falloff.

technical_specs.rendering: Fine grain, naturally detailed hair, accurate hands, realistic cooked food, and restrained soft bloom.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical cinematic night-market photograph of an adult woman with long dark wind-tossed hair, natural luminous skin, and a composed subtle smile. She wears a charcoal sleeveless high-neck top with relaxed dark high-waisted trousers and small plain silver earrings. Shoot a low-angle medium candid portrait while she holds two cooked barbecue skewers safely apart at chest height. Place her at a lively food stall under warm yellow bulbs with soft steam, distant anonymous shoppers, and abstract out-of-focus signage. Use 28mm street-film framing, shallow depth of field, fine grain, realistic cooked food, accurate hands, detailed hair, and restrained soft glow. Do not include anime characters, readable signs, logos, labels, or text.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, named character, anime character, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, skewer in mouth, unsafe pose, logos, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All identity references are optional and must show a consenting adult. Use location, food, and wardrobe references as replaceable guides only; never copy character IP, logos, or readable copy.
